description: This file contains unit tests for the WordsSQLiteConnectionPrefsProvider class, focusing on backup and load functionality of SQLite connections for different languages within the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: WordsSQLiteConnectionPrefsProviderTest
classes.description: Test class for WordsSQLiteConnectionPrefsProvider, verifying backup and load of language-specific SQLite word data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of WordsSQLiteConnectionPrefsProvider with language list 'en' and 'fr'.

methods.name: testId
methods.description: Verifies that the provider ID returned by the provider matches the expected string.

methods.name: testBackupAndLoad
methods.description: Tests the process of adding words to SQLite connections, backing up to preferences, deleting words, and restoring from preferences, ensuring data integrity throughout.
